before.name: wafsg-StandardAzureFileSharesPremiumShares
before.title: Understand how your bill is calculated: Standard Azure file shares provide a pay-as-you-go model. Premium shares use a provisioned model in which you specify and pay for a certain amount of capacity, IOPS, and throughput up front. In the pay-as-you-go model, meters track the amount of data that's stored in the account, or the capacity, and the number and type of transactions based on your usage of that data. The pay-as-you-go model can be cost efficient because you pay only for what you use. With the pay-as-you-go model, you don't need to overprovision or deprovision storage based on performance requirements or demand fluctuations.
